name: PREMIUM EDITORIAL VIRAL
about: Premium magazine look, planned scene by scene: fast but smooth jump cuts, punch-in zooms, cream caption cards, serif headlines, keyword highlights, your own screenshots floating over a dimmed background, UI panels, checklists, PiP, B&W transitions. A new idea every 2-4 s, timed to your words. Uses only your own files.
about_tl: Premium na itsura ng magasin, eksena por eksena: mabilis pero smooth na jump cut, punch-in zoom, cream na caption card, serif na headline, naka-highlight na keyword, sarili mong screenshots sa ibabaw ng dimmed na background, UI panel, checklist, PiP, B&W transition. Bagong idea kada 2-4 segundo, sabay sa sinasabi mo. Sarili mong files lang ang gamit.
instruction: Premium editorial look: fast but smooth cuts, calm and expensive-looking, never cluttered. Use only my own uploaded videos, photos, screenshots and brand files; no stock and no AI-made clips.
